lines.trans: Here, Marina, take a good look, please.
This is a very simple and kind girl Lyolya.
She has a very big and kind heart.
She always rushes to my aid.
She came and simply saved me today.
Very happy for you. And who are you?
Have you already finished talking completely?
No, I am not finished yet.
I came here to say goodbye to you forever.
Our brief relationship was a big mistake.
Get out of here, or I will pour milk on you!
There is your true nature! Let's go, Lyolya.
Mama, has Uncle Arkady left forever?
Do not worry, son, we will find someone else.

present есть; у меня есть = I have

meanings.note: at the start of a sentence
polite to one person, or to several people

examples.text: Он мне вылил кашу на голову!

говорить.gloss: to speak, to say, to talk

examples.text: Девушки, как я, у тебя не будет!
examples.trans: You'll never have a girl like me!

meanings.note: in greetings: добрый день, добрый вечер
masculine, but declined like a feminine noun in -я
colloquial, as children say; дяди из Москвы = some people from Moscow

meanings.en: to finish, to end, to complete

examples.trans: I want to finish what I started.
I was born and grew up here.
There's someone here to see you.

examples.text: Наши краткие отношения были большой ошибкой.
examples.trans: Our brief relationship was a big mistake.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

examples.text: А я испорчу отношения с будущим мэром.

переживать.gloss: to worry, to fret; to go through

examples.trans: Why are you worrying like that?
Don't worry, everything will be fine.

полюбоваться.gloss: to admire, take a look at

meanings.en: to admire, gaze at with pleasure/irony
meanings.note: look at with appreciation or irony

examples.trans: Here, Marina, take a good look, please.

попрощаться.gloss: to say goodbye, to bid farewell

examples.text: Я пришёл сюда навсегда попрощаться с тобой.

Security will be here any moment.

meanings.note: short form only: рад, рада, радо, рады; no long-form cases

спешить.gloss: to hurry, be in a rush

meanings.en: to hurry, rush, be in a hurry
meanings.note: куда ты спешишь? = where are you rushing to?

examples.trans: What happened? Where are you rushing to?

meanings.note: affectionate form of сын, often used as a form of address
